questions.question: The longest side of the obtuse triangle is 7 cm and the other two sides of the triangle are 4 cm and 5 cm. Find the area of the triangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct application of Heron's Formula is the fastest method here.

Semi-perimeter s = (4 + 5 + 7) ÷ 2 = 8 cm.

Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area = √[8 × (8 − 4) × (8 − 5) × (8 − 7)]

Area = √[8 × 4 × 3 × 1] = √96 = 4√6 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Area = 4√6 cm²

**Given:**

Lengths of the sides of the triangle are a = 4 cm, b = 5 cm, and c = 7 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula: Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Where 's' is the semi-perimeter of the triangle, given by s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, we calculate the semi-perimeter (s):

⇒ s = (4 + 5 + 7) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

⇒ Now, substitute the values into Heron's formula:

⇒ Area = √[8 × (8 − 4) × (8 − 5) × (8 − 7)]

⇒ Area = √[8 × 4 × 3 × 1]

⇒ Area = √96

⇒ Area = √(16 × 6)

⇒ Area = 4√6 cm²

*(Note: We can verify it is an obtuse triangle because 7² > 4² + 5² i.e., 49 > 16 + 25)*

**∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of any triangle when all three side lengths are known, without needing the height of the triangle.

Obtuse Triangle Condition

A triangle is classified as obtuse if the square of the longest side is strictly greater than the sum of the squares of the other two sides (c² > a² + b²).

Other Area Formulas

Area = (1 ÷ 2) × base × height. Alternatively, Area = (1 ÷ 2) × a × b × sin(C) if two sides and the included angle are given.

questions.question: What is the third proportion of the numbers 15 and 30?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First number (a) = 15

Second number (b) = 30

**Formula used:**

Third proportion = b²/a

**Calculation:**

Third proportion = b2/a

⇒ (30 × 30)/15

⇒ 30 × 2 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

questions.question: A purchased two articles for Rs 400 and Rs 600 respectively and sold at gains of 10% and 20% respectively. What was his overall gain percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) of first article = Rs.400

Profit on the first article = 10%

Cost price (C.P) of second article = Rs.600

Profit on the second article = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) + {C.P × (100 ± P/L)%}

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (profit × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

S.P of first article = 400 × 110% = Rs.440

S.P of second article = 600 × 120% = Rs.720

Total C.P = 1000

Total S.P = 1160

Profit = 1160 - 1000 = Rs.160

Profit% = (160 × 100)/1000

⇒ 16%

**∴ The correct answer is 16%. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

⇒ (X + 10)/(20 - X) = 600/400

⇒ (X + 10)/(20 - X) = 3/2

⇒ 2X + 20 = 60 - 3X

questions.question: In a field 8 workers complete a task in 22 days. If this task is to be completed in 44 days, then how many workers will be required?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8 workers complete a task in 22 days

**Concept used:**

M₁ × D₁ × H₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂

Where, M = Men ; D = day ; H = hour 

**Calculation:**

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

⇒ 8 × 22 = M2 × 44

⇒ M2 = (8 × 22)/44

⇒ M₂ = 4 workers

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

questions.question: The product of LCM and HCF of two number is 2028. If one number is 78, then what is the other number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

L.C.M × H.C.F = 2028

First number = 78

**Formula used:**

L.C.M × H.C.F = first number × second number

**Calculation:**

First number × second number = L.C.M × H.C.F

⇒ 78 × second number = 2028

⇒ Second number = 2028/78

⇒ Second number = 26

**∴ The correct answer is 26.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 7500 amounts to Rs. 15000 in two years at compound interest calculated annually. How much will Rs. 7500 becomes in four years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.7500

Time = 2 years

Amount = Rs.15000

**Formula used:**

(T₁)¹/ⁿ¹ = (T₂)¹/ⁿ²

**Calculation:**

In two years the principal becomes 2 times.

So,

⇒ (2)⁽¹/²⁾ = (4)⁽¹/ⁿ⁾ 

⇒ (2)(1/2) = (2)(2/n) 

base are the same then power must be equal.

⇒ (1/2) = (2/n)

⇒ n = 4

So, the principal becomes 4 times.

⇒ 7500 × 4 = Rs.30000

∴ The correct answer is Rs.30000.

questions.question: An article was sold at a loss of 14%. If it was sold for Rs. 756 more, then there would have been a gain of 7%. Find the cost price of the article.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss% = 14%

**Formula used:**

Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) - {Cost price (C.P) × (100 ± P/L)%}

**Calculation:**

The article sold at a loss of 14%.

C.P : S.P = 100 : 86

If the article will be sold at a profit of 7%.

C.P : S.P = 100 : 107

Now,

Difference of S.P = 756

⇒ (107 - 86) units = 756

⇒ 21 units = 756

⇒ 1 unit = Rs.36

⇒ 100 units = 36 × 100 = Rs.3600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.3600.**

questions.question: An auto rickshaw travels 20 km from point P to Q then 25 km from Q to R. The total time took was 1 hour 30 minutes. What was the average speed of the auto rickshaw?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance from P to Q = 20 km

Distance from Q to R = 25 km

Total time taken = 1 hr 30 minutes

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance/total time taken

**Calculation:**

Average speed = Total distance/total time taken

⇒ (20 + 25)/{1 + (1/2)}

⇒ 45 × 2/3 = 30 km/hr

** ∴ The correct answer is 30 km/hr**

Salary of A : Salary of B = 40 : 100 = 2 : 5

Percentage difference = {(5 - 2) × 100}/2

** ∴ The correct answer is 150%.**

questions.question: The speed of a bus is 108 km/hr. Find the distance covered by the bus in 2 seconds.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of bus = 108 km/hr

Time = 2 sec.

**Formula used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

108 km/hr = 108 × (5/18) = 30 m/s

Distance = speed × time

⇒ 30 × 2 = 60 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 60 m/s.**

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 : 7. The sum of the smallest and largest numbers is 44. What is the second smallest number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Let, the three numbers are A, B & C respectively.

A : B : C = 4 : 5 : 7

Smallest number + largest number = 44

**Calculation:**

 A : B : C = 4 : 5 : 7

According to the question:

⇒ (7 + 4) units = 11 units = 44

⇒ 1 unit = 4 

⇒ 5 units = 4 × 5 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

questions.question: A student scored 77, 80, 88, 73 and 62 marks out of 100 in five subjects. What are his average marks?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A student scored 77, 80, 88, 73 and 62 marks.

Total subject = 5

**Formula used:**

Average marks = sum of marks scored/total subject

**Calculation:**

Total marks scored = 77 + 80 + 88 + 73 + 62 = 380

Average marks = sum of marks scored/total marks

⇒ 380/5 = 76

**∴ The correct answer is 76.**
